title: 경찰병원 임상연구비 지급규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1

Article 6 (Amounts of Payment, etc.)
(1) Research expenses shall be paid within the budget for the relevant year.
(2) Research expenses shall be paid for only one project per person each year, and the research expenses per project shall not exceed 10 million won.
(3) Notwithstanding paragraph (2), where a research project is extensive and two or more persons jointly conduct a single project and publish the results in an academic journal, research expenses per project may be up to 25 million won.
(4) Details concerning the amounts of research expenses to be paid shall be separately determined by the Director of the National Police Hospital.
